text: Thirty grams of grapes, thirty grams of raisins: same weight, very different calories.
Grapes are about eighty percent water; drying removes most of it.
So thirty grams of grapes is about twenty-one calories, raisins about ninety, with four times the sugar.
Drying adds no sugar: those raisins started as about a hundred thirty grams of grapes.
Same sugar, just far less water.
